svg.title: Constrained decoding masks logits, not meaning
svg.desc: A hand-drawn whiteboard with a seven-state JSON state machine drawn as a chain from START to DONE with EXPECT_COLON highlighted as the current state, a bar chart of thirty vocabulary logits in which all but three are struck through in red and dropped to a hand-drawn minus-infinity floor while the colon, colon-space and whitespace tokens survive, two panels contrasting guaranteed syntax against unchanged F1 of 0.74, the claim that constrained decoding improves quality crossed out and corrected to parseability, and a grouped bar chart where schema validity climbs from 58.5 to 100 percent while field F1 moves only from 0.61 to 0.74.
svg.text: Constrained decoding masks logits, not meaning
logits over the vocabulary, this step
the model WANTED to write a
word here. It does not get
this is exactly top-k - but k is
chosen by a grammar, not by a number
put a free-text 'reasoning' field FIRST in
schema-valid % and field F1, same 200-item task
